# anecdotes_mapping_control_requirement (Resource)

Manages a link between an Anecdotes control and a requirement.

This resource creates the M:N relationship between controls and requirements, enabling
cross-framework requirement mapping. A single requirement can be linked to multiple
controls across different frameworks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "anecdotes_mapping_control_requirement" "mfa_link" {
  control_id     = anecdotes_control.access_control.control_id
  requirement_id = anecdotes_requirement.mfa.requirement_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `control_id` (String) The unique identifier of the control to link.
- `requirement_id` (String) The unique identifier of the requirement to link.

### Read-Only

- `framework_id` (String) The framework ID associated with the control-requirement link (computed).
